title.zh: 写实的眼：拟合与构造的尺寸、睑裂随注视 vs 文献
title.en: Lifelike eyes: fitted and constructed sizes, and the fissure with gaze, vs the literature

method.zh: 与加载时相同的计算（src/look/eyesFit.ts）：对每个人体扫描的巩膜做球面拟合；睑裂在注视 0°、±20°、−30° 时的高度用表情数据和睑随注视的通道（src/face/driver.ts）在发布的皮肤上算出，取最靠近瞳孔竖线的上下睑缘顶点之差，再与 0° 时相比。
method.en: The same computation as at load time (src/look/eyesFit.ts): a sphere fitted to each body's scanned sclera; the fissure height at 0°, ±20° and −30° gaze computed on the shipped skin with the expression data and the lid-follows-gaze channels (src/face/driver.ts), as the difference of the upper and lower lid-margin vertices nearest the pupil's vertical line, divided by the value at 0°.

tolerance.zh: 见每行：眼球半径到文献范围的边上、构造半径 ±1 mm、睑裂比值 ±0.06、角膜尺寸 1 SD。
tolerance.en: Per row: the eyeball radius up to the edges of the published range, the constructed radius ±1 mm, fissure ratios ±0.06, corneal sizes 1 SD.

references.name: Bekerman I, Gottlieb P, Vaiman M 2014, Variations in eyeball diameters of the healthy adults. J Ophthalmol 2014:503645
references.version: PMC4238270; CT of 250 adults: transverse diameter mean 24.2 mm, range about 21–27 mm
references.clause: Licence field of the Europe PMC record ("cc by"). Only the mean and range of the transverse diameter are used.

references.name: Mastropietro DA, Alves MR, Velasco e Cruz AA 2009, Upper and lower eyelid position in different degrees of downgaze and upgaze. Arq Bras Oftalmol 72(6):771–775
references.version: 10 normal subjects, −30° to +30°; means given in the text
references.licence: Not checked; no open licence is assumed
references.clause: No licence grant is relied on. Only the means given in the text are cited as facts.

references.name: Le Grand's full theoretical eye, as given in Atchison DA, Smith G, Optics of the Human Eye (2000)
references.licence: Not checked; no open licence is assumed
references.clause: No licence grant is relied on. A textbook value cited as a fact.

references.name: Rüfer F, Schröder A, Erb C 2005, White-to-white corneal diameter: normal values in healthy humans obtained with the Orbscan II topography system. Cornea 24(3):259–261
references.licence: Not checked; no open licence is assumed
references.clause: No licence grant is relied on. Only the mean and SD are cited as facts.

notes.zh: 这只眼是为显示构造的（来源"构造物"）；角膜尺寸等几行按定义与文献相等，列出来只是为了说明来源。
notes.en: This eye is built for display (provenance "construction"); the corneal rows equal the literature by definition and are listed only to show where the values come from.

rows.item: scanned eyeball radius (sphere fit to the sclera)

note.zh: 参照：横径平均 24.2 mm、范围约 21–27 mm 的一半；容差到范围边上
note.en: reference: half the transverse diameter, mean 24.2 mm and range about 21–27 mm; the tolerance reaches the range edges

note.zh: 构造的眼用拟合半径，限在平均值 ±1 mm 内（构造约束）
note.en: the constructed eye uses the fitted radius, held within ±1 mm of the mean (a construction constraint)

note.zh: 参照：睑裂 10.8 mm → −20° 时 8.7 mm、−30° 时 7.8 mm（文中均值）；容差 0.06 是本表所定
note.en: reference: fissure 10.8 mm → 8.7 mm at −20° and 7.8 mm at −30° (means in the text); the 0.06 tolerance is set by this table
